text: About {watch} min to watch. Starting after the ad.
reason: Gives the watch time and says it starts after the ad, so the wait during the ad makes sense.

text: That's everything worth watching.
reason: Without it they would not know why the video paused before the end: the remaining time has nothing worth watching.

text: Here is the transcript of the YouTube video "{title}". Each line starts with its timestamp. {EDIT} Each stretch must be a complete thought: start at the line where it begins, and end at the timestamp of the first line after it. {lines}
reason: Prompt sent to Gemini with the transcript; never shown.

text: Back to the full video
reason: Hover text while on; without it they would not know clicking again returns to the normal video.

text: Skipping to {clock()}: {label}
reason: Without it a jump forward looks like a glitch; it names where the video jumped to and why.

text: Finding good parts…
reason: Button label while waiting; without it they would not know the click registered and may click again.

text: Edit it like a condensed football game with the best plays marked: nothing of substance is lost, the downtime is cut, and the best moments stand out. List every stretch worth keeping, in time order, and mark each one: - highlight: the best stuff, the main points, key arguments, demos, surprising facts, and the conclusion. About a quarter of the video. - play: everything else with substance, such as smaller points, examples, numbers, and reasons. Never drop one because it seems minor. Leave out the downtime: sponsor reads (all of them, from the first sentence to the last), channel plugs, "like and subscribe", greetings and sign-offs, waiting for something to load, filler, rambling, repeating a point already made, and tangents that go nowhere. Stretches must not overlap.
reason: Instructions sent to Gemini in the request body; never shown in the page.

text: Good parts: on
reason: Button label while active; without it they could not tell skipping and speed changes are switched on.

text: Good parts
reason: The button's name; without it the button has no label.

text: A few plain words saying what this part covers
reason: Field description inside the answer format sent to Gemini; never shown.

text: Watch the best parts, speed through the rest
reason: Hover text while off; without it they would not know the button skips filler and changes speed.

text: Something went wrong. Refresh the page and try again.
reason: Shown after unexpected failures, mostly after the extension was reloaded in an open tab; refreshing the page is the fix they would not know.

text: Gemini had a problem with this video. Try again in a minute.
reason: Without it they would not know Gemini failed on this video and that retrying in a minute is the fix.

text: Gemini didn't find any parts to keep.
reason: Without it they would not know why nothing gets skipped: Gemini returned no parts.

text: Gemini is taking too long. Try again in a minute.
reason: Without it they would not know the button stopped working because Gemini timed out, or that waiting a minute fixes it.

text: Your Gemini key isn't working. Paste a new one in the settings tab.
reason: Without it they would not know the saved key is the problem or where to put a new one (the settings tab opens alongside it).

text: Good Parts will start after the ad.
reason: Without it they would think the click did nothing; nothing can start until the ad ends.

text: About {watch} min instead of {round()}. Best parts play as usual, the rest at 2x, filler skipped.
reason: First sentence gives the time saved; second explains the coming speed changes and skips, which would otherwise look like glitches.

text: Couldn't reach Gemini. Check your internet.
reason: Without it they would not know the request never reached Gemini and that their connection is the thing to check.

text: Highlight: {label}
reason: Without it they would not know the slowdown is on purpose or what the highlight is about.

text: Gemini is busy or out of free uses for today. Try again later.
reason: Without it they would keep clicking; it says the daily free limit or a busy service is the cause and to come back later.

text: This video has no captions, so this can take a minute or two.
reason: Without it they would think it froze; videos without captions take a minute or two instead of seconds.

text: Add your Gemini key first.
reason: Without it they would not know the settings tab opened because a Gemini key is required before anything works.

text: Watch this YouTube video. {EDIT} Each stretch must be a complete thought: start just before it begins and end after it lands, never mid-sentence. Write timestamps as M:SS or H:MM:SS using the video's own clock.
reason: Prompt sent to Gemini when a video has no captions; never shown.

text: Get a free key from Google
reason: Link label; tells them where to get a key and that it costs nothing.

text: Good Parts sends each video's captions to Google's Gemini to find the best parts. Gemini needs a key.
reason: Tells them video captions are sent to Google and why the key is needed; they would not otherwise know where their data goes.

text: Save
reason: Button label; without it the button has no name.

text: Good Parts settings
reason: Tab title; without it the settings tab has no name among other tabs.

text: Gemini key
reason: Field label; without it they would not know what to paste into the box.
